line: Young nigga with a .38 (Young nigga with a .38) Young nigga with a .38 (Young nigga with a .38) Seventeen with the .38 (Seventeen with the .38) I was seventeen with the .38 (Seventeen with the .38)
vault_lines: Young nigga with a .38 (Young nigga with a .38)
meaning:
These lines, as well as the title of the track are partially derived from a lyric on “Momma” from Kendrick Lamar’s critically acclaimed album  To Pimp a Butterfly where he says:

Ah, I thought I found you, back in the ghetto
When I was seventeen with the .38 Special

line: Slow down, slow down’s what my mama said (Mama said) She couldn’t get that shit through my head (Through my head) You can’t expect me to give respect (Respect) When I would fuck bitches on mama bed
vault_lines: Slow down, slow down's what my mama said (Mama said)
meaning:
Jay’s mother often tried to talk some sense into him about his behavior and wrongdoings in life and towards women, but it wasn’t worthwhile.

Later through the album, on the song “No Shoes On the Rug, Leave Them At the Door”, while rapping through the perspective of his mother, he admits that he eventually realized that he was wrong:

Do you understand what I was tryna say?
Oh now you understand what I was tryna say
But even though you make me mad and never listen

In the song “Dog Love Kitty” Jay shows that he often mistreats women who get involved with him, and on the next track he gets slapped by his mother after saying:

Mama, that ain’t my girlfriend, that’s my bitch

In his 14-minute short visual project for the album, after he gets slapped by his mother, the animated visual for the song “Windows Up” starts. In an interview with Noisey, IDK commented:

When my mom slapped me, I wanted it to put me in another world. It’s almost like she’s slapping some sense into me. The animation was the best way to do that.

line: Hit the Georgetown (Swerve) I got whores now (Swerve)
meaning: Georgetown is a fairly populated neighborhood in the Washington D.C., comprised of many restaurants and shopping centers. The area is also known for the highly prestigious college Georgetown University. Therefore, IDK is claiming to go to a nearby school and pick up some college girls for a brief relationship.

line: Polo wasn’t Ralph (Word) It’s a horse now
meaning: Polo Ralph Lauren is a very recognizable brand of high-class clothing and is very easily faked by off-brand companies looking to cash in on the market. The way to tell if Polo is fake is to see if there is a horse in the top right of the shirt, so IDK is saying that he used to wear off-brand Polos before he started to rob white people and earn some good money in order to afford better clothes.

vault_lines: This that dirty stinkin' nasty ratchet rowdy shit
meaning:
IDK told Consequence of Sound that Chief Keef scrapped his original verse because he wasn’t happy with it.

He did it the first time and didn’t like it, so he scrapped it and did it again and sent me the new verse. The new verse was like really good. He was really trying to rap. I don’t know if he was trying to keep up with me or what.
